Kosar is the first Iranian satellite with an average resolution of 3.45 meters GSD.
Description

Kosar is the first space product of SpaceOMID. Kosar project has started in summer 2018.

This satellite follows the standards of a CubeSat, which reduces the time and costs of manufacturing. This satellite is equipped with cameras in NIR and RGB spectrum.

Kosar is the first Iranian satellite with an average resolution of 3.45 meters GSD, which makes it the most advanced Iranian satellite so far. It provides services in precision agriculture and mapping.
